description.en:
A top-down flyover editor for AutoDrive route networks - build and repair routes from above, on foot or in a vehicle, without driving every metre of them.
Tools: draw, move, delete, name, spline, divide, smooth, convert, straighten, field loop, merge, parallel, siding and ground. Span tools work on a picked span or a whole run between junctions. Everything is undoable.
Open it with Left Alt + F (rebindable in the controls menu), or the button beside AutoDrive's HUD. Esc to leave.
Requires FS25_AutoDrive to be installed and active. This mod does not modify AutoDrive's files; it attaches at runtime and refuses to load if it cannot. Do not run it alongside a modified AutoDrive build that includes its own flyover editor.
Single player only.
